report: WS-5c landed all of D0–D7 across 8 atomic commits (efefaa8..3e143b8), diff strictly confined to apps/shell/ (37 files), zero new Python deps, zero paid LLM calls. Two new contracts are in: the Tailwind v4 + @theme token-bridge + shadcn foundation (theme.css bridges the single styles.css token source; 9 primitives) and the §5b tool-<name>→component registry (AI-SDK message-parts shape; renderTool + graceful fallback; 5 tools). Monitor watch-item #1 honored — FlagEditor surfaces per-flag tier/gradeable/owners and the GLOBAL severity_map as two distinct sections (severity is not per-flag). Watch-item #2 honored — the foundation is genuinely exercised: the 3 input widgets render real shadcn Button/Select/Slider/Switch/Dialog/Card on the @theme tokens (registry+inputs tests render them), while the ported datapoint cards stay faithful on .icard CSS (incremental, SPEC §4). S-BS-17 closed (Shell mock converged to clinical/Scribe — shell/journey/harness now agree); S-BS-18 closed (Vitest+RTL infra + the bff.js→ReportTab binding test; 18 passed). Mode-switch moved out of the fixed overlay into both titlebars. Verdict is PROCEED-WITH-CAVEATS for ONE reason: live visual parity of the bespoke chrome under Tailwind's Preflight was NOT eyeballed at :5180 (no-autostart standing rule). It is guaranteed by construction — styles.css is unlayered and unlayered CSS wins the cascade over Tailwind's @layer base Preflight — and the build is clean, but the monitor/critic should do a 60-second :5180 smoke (light + dark, both modes) to confirm. Two low seams opened: S-BS-19 (journey doesn't yet emit input tool-parts → WS-5d) and S-BS-20 (Radix popover/drag interactions not E2E-tested in jsdom). POST-CLOSE CORRECTION (commit 0c13d3f, user-approved after handback): the user flagged Journey↔Shell inconsistency (wrong logo, different rail layout, jumpy mode-switch); fixed by giving Journey the Shell's 46px Wordmark brand bar (canonical logo = Wordmark everywhere), anchoring the mode-switch to a stable post-lights slot in both titlebars, and aligning Journey pane defaults to Shell — removing the toggle layout-shift. This confirms the value of the deferred :5180 visual smoke. The deferred :5180 smoke (light/dark × Shell/Journey) is still owed at close to eyeball the now-fixed titlebar + chrome parity.
